title: Decide and document Cloudflare's edge, security, storage, and deployment boundary
desired_change: Record an explicit adopt/adapt/reject decision for Cloudflare products. If adopted, name account/project, Workers versus Pages role, DNS/WAF/Turnstile/R2/Queues use, Git or Wrangler deployment, preview branches, secrets, observability, rollback, source receipts, and overlap rules with Vercel and Supabase. If rejected, make non-use explicit.
expected_outcome: Cloudflare becomes a deliberate bounded dependency rather than a hidden account configuration or duplicate runtime.

risk.rights_or_safety_impact: Undocumented edge configuration can create deployment drift, secret exposure, duplicate routing, or provider lock-in.

hidden_context_dependencies: The PR contains no Cloudflare manifest, Wrangler configuration, account/project identifier, or role decision.
Live Cloudflare account state could not be inspected from the current connected tool surface.
Potential overlap among Cloudflare Pages/Workers, Vercel, and Supabase is unresolved.
No deployment, security, observability, rollback, or environment contract exists.
acceptance_checks: The decision names adopt, adapt, reject, or defer with rationale.
If adopted, preview and production deployment paths are distinct and commit-addressable.
Vercel/Cloudflare/Supabase responsibility overlap is prohibited or explicitly resolved.
Secrets and outbound access are bounded.
